cues.txt: Today I'm going to combine two of my

stoves. And I'm going to build my dream
pizza oven fueled by a rocket stove.
I've partnered with Hobart on this video

easy for all of the welding. Now, I've
built a few unique rocket stoves on the
channel before, and I'm really excited

cool to change that over to a wood fire
on a rocket stove. Now, before I get too
far down the road designing any project,
I like to think through what I actually
want to get out of it, some
requirements, if you will. And so, in
this case, things like I want even
cooking. I want an easy clean out so you
don't have to dig a bunch of ash out. I
want it to be freestanding so I don't
have to bend over. Adjustable
temperature. Those sorts of things.
